source.dataset: Stanford Dogs Dataset (Khosla, Jayadevaprakash, Yao, Fei-Fei; FGVC Workshop, CVPR 2011)
source.independent_checksum_match: sha256 and size equal to tensorflow_datasets/datasets/stanford_dogs/checksums.tsv (GitHub, master)
source.retrieval_note: Local DNS returned NXDOMAIN for vision.stanford.edu; the host was resolved via DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare and Google both: CNAME ai.stanford.edu -> 171.64.68.10) and fetched over plain HTTP, the scheme used by the official page link (HTTPS on that IP presents a certificate for another name). Authenticity is supported by the independent TFDS checksum match.
source.extraction_checks: regular files only, no absolute paths, no '..', single path component, tarfile filter='data'
source.images_and_annotations: pre-existing local copies in data/images/Images and data/annotations/Annotation; not re-downloaded, not modified
source.terms: Images originate from ImageNet; use is limited to non-commercial research/educational purposes per ImageNet terms. Images are not redistributed by this repository.

duplicates.decision: official test is not modified; duplicates inside official train are kept on one side of train/val; train/val copies of test images and label-conflict copies are removed from train/val (see 'leakage')
duplicates.impact: train/val<->test copies leak test images into training (optimistic test metrics); cross-class copies are label conflicts that cap achievable accuracy. Evaluation should additionally report test metrics without the listed test ids.

leakage.policy: remove from train/val every record whose exact content (sha256) also occurs in official test, and every record whose content occurs with another breed label; official test is never modified, its records are flagged instead

limitations: Stanford Dogs is built from ImageNet images and the backbone is initialised with ImageNet-1k weights, which may have seen some official test images; test metrics are optimistic and not an independent external evaluation.
Largest-box policy: in multi-dog frames the crop may contain other dogs or, with noisy annotations, a dog of another breed (see reports/dataset_visual_check.md).
Label-conflict copies remain inside the untouched official test (flag label_conflict).

coordinate_convention.source_xml: origin (0,0) = top-left pixel of the stored image (no EXIF rotation); xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax are inclusive 0-based pixel indices
coordinate_convention.project: (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) with exclusive xmax/ymax, matching PIL.Image.crop
coordinate_convention.out_of_bounds: clipped to the image and reported per record as 'bbox_clipped'
coordinate_convention.exif: boxes refer to stored pixels; records with EXIF orientation 2..8 are excluded and reported (training images are not EXIF-transposed)

crop_policy.box_selection: largest valid box by area; ties -> earliest <object> in XML order
crop_policy.manifest_bbox: normalized original box (no context); context is applied on the fly
crop_policy.min_size: no minimum size for dataset boxes (upload ROI limits do not apply)

validation_split.method: sklearn.model_selection.train_test_split(stratify=class_id, shuffle=True) over one representative per exact-duplicate group (smallest image_id), sorted; other group members follow their representative
validation_split.duplicate_policy: exact duplicates inside official train never straddle train/val

visual_check.status: generated; manual review result recorded separately
visual_check.legend: red = normalized bbox, green = bbox + context, right = final crop
